title: Kafka consumer group rebalance livelock under prolonged heartbeat thread latency
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0210: Kafka consumer group rebalance livelock under prolonged heartbeat thread latency
Repository: `hashicorp/raft`
Category: `Distributed Consensus & Partitioning`
Target File: `clients/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/internals/AbstractCoordinator.java`

#### Problem Description
Heartbeat thread blocked by synchronous coordinator poll causes broker to repeatedly trigger partition rebalance.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Decouple heartbeat execution into dedicated daemon thread with separate keep-alive socket.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0210.py -q`
expected_invariant: Decouple heartbeat execution into dedicated daemon thread with separate keep-alive socket.
